title: Authorized chats, WebSocket and files
intent: Implement chat membership, deterministic message history, typed WebSocket events and authenticated RustFS S3-compatible object storage access on the owned backend.

requirements.title: Chats, WS and files
requirements.description: Provide member-authorized chats, deterministic cursor history pagination, idempotent message send/receive envelopes compatible with the current {type, content} shape and authenticated upload/download through the existing RustFS S3-compatible service.

constraints: Stage 5 auth/database seam is consumed; controller-owned router registration is the only central composition change.
Membership checks are server-side on HTTP, WS and files.
The WebSocket envelope remains compatible with the master-plan {type, content} shape; history and error payloads are typed extensions.
File contract is explicit for RAG and bot consumers, with backend-authorized streaming downloads and server-generated object keys.
RustFS endpoint, credentials, bucket and boto3 synchronous S3 client dependency are controller-owned integration seams; bucket provisioning is idempotent and no MinIO service is introduced.
No frontend, course CI or local-model integration writes.
